title: Entrance totem

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Make an institution identifiable before a visitor reaches its door, because arrival needs a clear visual destination.
strategic_value: The bright circular mark against the dark totem can distinguish the Museum within its ornate architectural setting.
demonstration: A tall dark sign places the colored symbol near its top and the stacked museum name near its base beside the building and railings.
practical_value: Compare how a vertically separated symbol and name remain readable on an entrance marker.

content_islands.name: Identification sign
content_islands.spec: Place the circular mark high on the dark upright and the white stacked name low on the same face.

content_islands.name: Arrival context
content_islands.spec: Keep the stone façade and fence visible around the sign to establish physical scale and contrast.
